description: §64.6 E-TOOL-006 — a `kind="tool"` program imports a local `.scrml` file that is page-shaped (a top-level `<program>` with markup), not an importable library.
rationale: §64.5.1: "A tool may import only an IMPORTABLE local `.scrml` module — a §21.5 library-shaped file (exports-bearing, no top-level `<program>` / page markup) … A tool importing a page-shaped / no-export `.scrml` is `E-TOOL-006` (fail-closed; §64.6)."
